messages:
Sara (sara): quick follow-up from the RFC — we started seeing a small cluster of regressions on the shadow fp8 path during yesterday's canary, want to sync on mitigations
Michael (michael): saw that, thanks. initial hypothesis: sampling bias in the shadow traffic + a pathological prompt family that loses numeric stability in fp8 attention kernels
Raj (raj): +1. dug into the traces: degradation score spikes line up with long math-heavy prompts, high token counts, and some unusual softmax tails
Amelia (amelia): do we have a reproducible minimal example? if we can repro locally we can try toggling scale-preserve flags or switch to int8 for just attention kernels
Sara (sara): I have one small example, attaching snippet in thread. can't paste large content here but it reproduces ~3x MSE vs fp32 on a 4k input
Lucas (lucas): oncall note: the canary rollback is ready if needed, we haven't hit alerts yet but want a short mitigation plan
Michael (michael): proposal: (1) add a short-circuit that routes prompts with > 2048 numeric tokens to int8 fallback, (2) shadow-sampling: bias sampling to include more long/math prompts during shadowing so we catch earlier
Raj (raj): +1 to sampling bias. we should also add a quick statistical bucketing in the profiler so we don't miss low-frequency failure modes
Amelia (amelia): sketch of a conservative config we can flip remotely:
```
precision_fallback:
  thresholds:
    long_numeric_prompt: 2048
    softmax_tail_entropy: 0.12
  fallbacks:
    attention: INT8
    weights: FP8
```
Michael (michael): that looks safe. runtime note: switching attention to int8 adds ~12-20% latency on long contexts but keeps quality. acceptable for canary fallback
Raj (raj): will add a telemetry alert when softmax_tail_entropy crosses 0.12 and sample counts>50 in a minute. helps avoid noise from rare outliers
Sara (sara): ops question: can we make the sampling bias incremental? i.e., weight long/math prompts x3 in shadow for 48h and then re-evaluate
Lucas (lucas): yes, can do via the shadow-sampler flag. I'll coordinate with infra to push a temporary sampling weight change to 3x for the next 48h
deploy-bot: shadow-sampler: toggle requested by lucas — increase weight for bucket long_numeric_prompt to 3 for 48h. ID: sb-7831
Amelia (amelia): while that's running i'll prepare a bench harness to compare fp8 vs int8 attention on the minimal repro and produce token-level divergence plots
Michael (michael): nice — can you also run a quick sweep toggling `preserve_sign_scale=true/false` in the attention kernel? that was suspicious in earlier PRs
Amelia (amelia): will do. expected turnaround ~3 hours
Sara (sara): next steps: lucas flips sampling, amelia runs benches and posts plots, raj wires telemetry bucketing + alert, michael drafts a short-run fallback playbook if we need a rollback. Re-evaluate in 24h or earlier if alert fires
Raj (raj): logging action item: add a compact fingerprint to the trace so we can quickly surface prompt families causing regressions (hash + feature tags)
Lucas (lucas): noted. i'll schedule the sampling change and confirm here when live
Sara (sara): thanks all. quick and pragmatic — goal: avoid user impact while we find root cause
Michael (michael): 👍
Amelia (amelia): ping me if you want the bench script or raw traces earlier
Lucas (lucas): shadow-sampler live (sb-7831) — weight=3 for long_numeric_prompt for 48h
Sara (sara): perfect, closing the loop until benches come back
